uncertainty.note: residual_mae is the NESTED out-of-fold error of this procedure, not the in-sample fit. rater_noise_floor_mae is the mean absolute deviation from each repeated scenario's own mean label - the error a perfect model would still make because the rater did not repeat themselves. Treat it as a lower bound, not a target. A previous build stamped rater_self_disagreement: 0.333 here, which is not reproducible from this corpus.

notes: trained on human labels only; expert rule is never the target
monotone in wind_mph, gust_mph, gust_delta_mph, beaufort, wave_height_m, precip_mm (non-increasing) and visibility_km (non-decreasing)
